$schema_note: Modular brand config — the single file you swap to rebrand the entire content pipeline. Starter template: replace every <angle-bracket> value with your brand's. Colors/typography here are neutral defaults.

brand.name: <Your Brand>
brand.product_summary: <2-3 sentences: what the product actually is and does — the analyzers and interview read this>

visual_style.illustration: Indian miniature / Rajasthani-Mughal painting style figures interacting with modern market motifs (stock tickers on coins, phone in hand). Warm paper texture, subtle grain/noise overlay.
visual_style.ui_shape: pill buttons (999px radius), 18-24px card radius, hairline borders, flat (no drop shadows)
visual_style.mood: warm, trustworthy, desi-modern; cream + deep green; editorial serif headlines over clean sans

video_defaults.creator_accent: Indian English (override Higgsfield default US accent)

compliance.note: Replace with your market's real rules. These are generic platform/FTC baselines, not legal advice.
required_disclosures: AI-generated content is labeled as such where required
hard_rules: No promises of future returns; historical performance is never a promise
Personas never claim personal experience they don't have (no fake testimonials)
Every on-screen figure resolves to an evidence-ledger id
Claims must be factually true and legally available for the target geography
